speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am banking the hall fire, sir. One fire. It is for the people who are eating. I am not laying a plate where you will not be.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Do not lay one. I said so when the dish was still in her hands. The sheet upstairs is still not for the street.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: I have the spoons in my hand and I am not putting them down to discuss Blackfriars. Six was said. It does not improve by being said again. If you are hungry, that is a fact about noon, and noon is over.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am not asking about the ass. I had the jaw at noon. The sand is in the box, and the sheet is not in my hand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Leave both. I will be late. I will not ask anyone to sit up.
